sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:39 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 4 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Standing by to charge the Ops phone, battery at 15%, before commencing routes.
Still standing by to recharge the Ops phone.
Still standing by to recharge the Ops phone.
Still standing by to recharge the Ops phone.
Ops phone at a healthy battery percentage; commencing Alpha Route. Arrived at check-in Corner of Victoria St East and Queen Street Headquarters. All clear.
Arrived at check-in Skyworld Entertainment Center and Aotea Square. All clear.
Full sweep around the square and welfare check on nearby buildings and stores. All clear.
Walkthrough Bledisdoe building alleyway behind Skyworld Entertainment Center. All clear.
Response call from Chancery Square carpark, Bacon Lane, regarding a rough sleeper in carpark P1. Assistance requested to move him along.
Arrived at the response call; carpark security directed us to where the individual was last seen, but he had already left. His name is Joseph.
Carpark security took us into their office to obtain an image of the individual.
Response call from Sierra Cafe, Lorne Street, regarding two individuals who stole food. Assistance requested at the cafe.

Arrived at the response call; the individuals had left 10 minutes before the call reached us. The cafe will send a picture; we advised them to call us immediately next time, before approaching. Muffins were taken.
Response call from Ravi, Datacentre, reporting a homeless individual inside the level 1 kitchen area.

Arrived at level 1 Datacentre; Ravi had kept the door closed until we arrived. We escorted the individual outside and issued a verbal trespass warning that Police will be called if he returns. He matches the description given by Sierra Cafe for the stolen muffins; he had eaten one of the guards' lunches from the fridge.
Standing by in the middle of Queen Street awaiting Team 2 deployment.
Commencing routes again — Team 1 covering the lower half of Queen Street while Team 2 covers upper Queen Street.
Welfare check on stores along Queen Street towards Britomart Square. All clear:
Welfare check on Durham Street East and West alleyway businesses within the vicinity. All clear.
Welfare check and building sweep around Imperial Lane. All clear.
Welfare check Queens Arcade. All clear.
Arrived at check-in Commercial Bay; full sweep around the area. All clear.
Standing by to maintain visible presence before moving to the next checkpoint.
Ending Alpha Route and commencing Echo Route.
Arrived at check-in Queens Arcade. All clear.
Arrived at check-in corner of Shortland St and Queen St. All clear.
Welfare check on stores along lower High Street towards Chancery Square. All clear:
Arrived at check-in Chancery Square and Freyberg Square; full sweep around the area. All clear.
Heading to swap with Team 2; we will patrol upper Queen Street while they patrol lower Queen Street.
Changeover of patrols. During changeover, received a response call from Cotton On reporting a female who had stolen clothes, last seen heading into Nike.
Arrived with Team 2 and confronted the female at the entrance to Nike; she returned the clothes and was given a verbal warning.
Response call from Albert Mart Convenience Store regarding a thief; Team 2 sent to deal with the situation.
Arrived at check-in corner of Darby St and Queen St. All clear.
Call back from Team 2: the individual got away with a $2 ice block, last seen heading to Commercial Bay (photo on file).
Response call from Doshan, 131 Queen Street, regarding a vagrant in front of the building. Team 2 sent to respond.
Arrived at check-in top of Victoria Street West and Federal St. All clear.
Heading back to Headquarters for lunch break.
Lunch break completed; standing by for changeover to Afternoon shift.

sections.title: Day Shift — Team 2 (09:00 – 17:00)
items: Equipment: 1 x Camera, 1 x Radio, 2 x Vests.
Standing by at HQ debriefing with Team 1 who have just arrived at HQ.
Commencing patrols on upper Queen Street. Welfare checks:
Brief meeting with Team 1 complete — no issues to report. Commencing patrol up Queen Street.
Welfare checks completed, all clear, nothing to report.
Welfare sweep complete, no issues; heading up to Victoria. (Note: rain starting — patrol limited to sheltered areas if weather escalates.)
Arrived at Victoria St; welfare check completed on Elliott and Darby, no issues. Commencing welfare sweep.
Full welfare sweep on Victoria St complete, no issues; heading to Lorne St for welfare check and to maintain security presence.
Arrived at Lorne St; completed a full welfare sweep, no issues from local stores.
Upper Queen St patrol complete, no issues or response calls. Standing by maintaining security presence on Queen St.
Security presence on upper Queen St maintained, no issues. Commencing welfare sweeps on:
Welfare check on Lorne St complete, no issues.
Welfare sweep on Victoria St and Federal St complete, no issues.
Welfare checks complete; no issues from stores or public, no response calls. Maintaining security presence on Queen St until changeover with Team 1.
Heading back to HQ for route changeover.

Response call: a male had just stolen from Albert Mart; suspect left before arrival, last seen heading towards Customs Street. Suspect: Caucasian male, slender, approx 5'6"-5'9", brown hair, dark blue pants, black hoodie with white and green sleeves. Commencing a full sweep of Customs and Commercial Bay; store requested a verbal trespass. No further issues.
Response call from 131 Queen St requesting assistance to move along a vagrant.
Arrived at 131 Queen St; the vagrant had already moved on, no further issues. Resuming patrol on lower Queen St heading to Chancery.
Full welfare sweep on High St and Freyberg Square, no issues from local stores.
Chancery Square welfare sweep complete, no issues. Continuing patrol to Fort/Gore.
Welfare sweep on the rest of High St, clear.
Vulcan Lane welfare sweep clear. Heading back to lower Queen St to maintain presence until route changeover at HQ.
Standing by at HQ debriefing with Team 1 before route changeover and break.
Debriefing complete, no issues; route changeover clear. Commencing welfare checks up Queen St.
Welfare check on all local stores on upper Queen St, clear; making our way to Aotea.
Aotea Square welfare sweep complete, no issues; heading to Victoria St while maintaining presence.
Welfare sweep through Elliott/Darby St clear; continuing patrol to Victoria.
Victoria welfare sweep clear, no issues from stores or public. Heading down to Lorne St.
Arrived at Lorne St; commencing welfare sweep.
Lorne St welfare sweep clear; making our way to Auckland Library.
Auckland Library welfare check clear; moving back to upper Queen St to maintain presence.
Upper Queen St welfare sweeps complete, no issues. Standing by while maintaining presence.
Response call from management reporting a vagrant loitering and smoking marijuana outside Nike. Heading over.
Arrived at Nike; the individual was no longer there, no issues. Management informed. Posting up outside the office to catch up on reports while staying vigilant.
Reports up to date; commencing final sweep before Team 2 stand down.
Final sweep complete — no issues from upper Queen St stores or public. Heading back to HQ for stand down:
Team 2 standing down; no issues to report, all equipment handed over.

Ops phone at 50%; heading out on routes.

Welfare check on stores along Queen Street towards Britomart Square.
Welfare check on Durham Street East and West alleyway and businesses within the vicinity. All clear.
Standing by at the intersection of Wyndham and Queen Street to maintain presence — peak hour and a known theft hot zone — before moving along.

Welfare check on Vulcan Lane businesses within the vicinity. All clear.
Response call from management regarding a male smoking cannabis in front of Nike on a scooter.
Called Team 2 to attend the call within their patrol area.
Heading back to Headquarters to tag Team 2 for changeover.
Arrived back at Headquarters; tagged Team 2 to level 1.
Arrived at check-in Commercial Bay; full sweep around the area. All clear.
Welfare check and walkthrough along Albert Street towards Aotea Square.
Standing by at Headquarters for a building sweep before returning to routes.

Response call from Macca's Queen Street regarding a couple with a dog near their entrance; on arrival they were just in front of the store window and were compliant with our request to move. Footage on the Eagle duress camera for Auror reports if required.
Building sweep completed; returning to routes.
Most stores now closed, except some businesses still trading after hours.
Response call from McDonald's Britomart regarding a male being disruptive inside the restaurant; manager requested assistance to remove him.
Arrived at McDonald's Britomart; informed the male he had to leave due to being a disturbance. He complied. Standing by to maintain presence (footage on body camera).
Male departed the premises but continued yelling and being a disturbance; standing by.
Welfare check around the square and nearby stores. All clear.
Welfare check Shortland Street Convenience Store. All clear.
Standing by corner of High St and Victoria Street East. All clear.
Arrived at HQ charging the Ops phone due to low battery (percentage shown on office camera).
Response call from Macca's Queen Street regarding the same male inside the store being aggressive towards the self-pay machine. Assistance requested.
Arrived and asked the individual to leave; he complied and left.
Response call from 175 Durham Street West alleyway regarding individuals sleeping on the stairs/entrance. Arrived, woke them, and asked them to leave; they complied. Standing by until they leave.
Individuals have left the premises. All response-call footage is on the Eagle duress camera.
Patrolling up and down Queen Street maintaining presence while awaiting response calls.
Meal break completed; standing by for changeover to Night shift.
